_why: Fleet 01M883AEHTJWZH95JSY1MSKEFX (PM ruling): seats of the singularaion account pool hit the Claude cap before reset, so their mechanical roles resolve to a non-Claude engine. Engines in order: agy first (pace-roles.json priority, carbon pool), then the scarce codex pools codex A and codex B (model/runner as in pace-roles.json pools).
